about: The board's Sparks lane and its Killed list (the owner's live order, 2026-10-11: the board is X-WOW's heartbeat). A spark is an idea that passed gate 0 (it makes something hidden, too small, too fast or too faint visible). It has no bar, and it claims nothing new until its prior-art search is done: prior_art says 'not yet searched' until then. A spark becomes a card only after the charter's triage and an AI review; it is then marked carded with the card's id. A killed idea stays listed with its reason and date. tools/board.py renders this file; 'new' marks are computed from 'added' at build time. Nothing about visitors is stored anywhere.

sparks.line_en: A phone camera reads its picture one row at a time, so a single photo of something fast (a plucked string, a spinning fan) holds a time-line in its stripes.
sparks.line_zh: 手机相机是一行一行读出画面的，所以给快速运动的东西（拨动的琴弦、转动的风扇）拍一张照片，条纹里就藏着一条时间线。
sparks.why_en: It could measure speeds and frequencies far too fast for the eye with nothing but the phone in your pocket.
sparks.why_zh: 也许只用口袋里的手机，就能测出眼睛根本跟不上的速度和频率。
sparks.prior_art_en: not yet searched (rolling-shutter measurement is studied in research; we will credit what we find)
sparks.prior_art_zh: 还没检索（研究界已有利用卷帘快门做测量的工作，找到后会注明出处）

sparks.line_en: Lay one printed line pattern over another and a movement too small to see becomes broad bands sweeping across the sheet.
sparks.line_zh: 把两张印着细线的透明片叠在一起，小到看不见的移动就会变成在纸上扫过的宽条纹。
sparks.why_en: Two printed sheets might measure tiny bending or swelling, with the bands doing the magnifying.
sparks.why_zh: 两张印出来的片子，也许就能量出极小的弯曲或膨胀，放大的工作交给条纹来做。
sparks.prior_art_en: not yet searched (moiré methods are long established; we will credit them)
sparks.prior_art_zh: 还没检索（莫尔纹测量方法早已有之，我们会注明出处）

sparks.line_en: Many phone and laptop screens give out polarised light; with a second polarising film, raw starch grains glow with dark crosses that fade once the starch is cooked.
sparks.line_zh: 很多手机和电脑屏幕发出的是偏振光；再加一张偏振片，生淀粉颗粒会亮起带黑十字的光，淀粉煮熟后十字就消失了。
sparks.why_en: It would show cooking happen at the level of how molecules are packed, using a screen you already own. Raw and already-cooked food side by side; any heating is an adult's job.
sparks.why_zh: 用你已经有的屏幕，就能看见烹饪在分子排列层面发生的变化。生的和已经煮好的食物并排比较；任何加热都由大人来做。

sparks.line_en: A leaf kept in the dark and then lit gives off a faint red glow that rises and falls over seconds to minutes as photosynthesis starts up (the Kautsky effect).
sparks.line_zh: 叶子先在黑暗里放一阵再照亮，会发出微弱的红光，几秒到几分钟里先变亮再变暗，那是光合作用在启动（卡乌茨基效应）。
sparks.why_en: A filtered phone camera might watch that curve, a clock of the leaf's own machinery, with ordinary visible light only.
sparks.why_zh: 加了滤光片的手机相机也许能拍下这条曲线，像一只记录叶子内部机器的钟；只用普通可见光。
sparks.prior_art_en: not yet searched (the Kautsky effect is classic plant science; we will credit it)
sparks.prior_art_zh: 还没检索（卡乌茨基效应是经典的植物学现象，我们会注明出处）

sparks.line_en: Laser light scattered off a living seedling makes a grainy speckle that shimmers as cells move and grow. This is biospeckle, an established research method; the spark is only about making it cheap and safe.
sparks.line_zh: 激光照在活的幼苗上会散射出颗粒状的散斑，细胞一动、一长，散斑就闪动。这叫生物散斑，是已有的研究方法；这个点子只是想让它变得便宜又安全。
sparks.why_en: How fast the speckle changes could show growth a camera can't see directly. Only a sealed Class 1 or 2 laser product, handled by an adult and never pointed at anyone's eyes.
sparks.why_zh: 散斑变化的快慢，也许能显示相机直接看不到的生长。只用密封的 1 类或 2 类激光产品，由大人操作，绝不对着任何人的眼睛。
sparks.prior_art_en: biospeckle research comes first; the search for cheap versions is not yet done
sparks.prior_art_zh: 生物散斑研究在先；便宜做法的检索还没做

sparks.from_zh: X-WOW 的切片扫描仪档案和变小探险
sparks.line_en: A phone, a printed stage and free hosting might turn any school's box of slides into an explorable SHRINK world.
sparks.line_zh: 一部手机、一个 3D 打印的载物台和免费托管，也许能把任何学校的一盒玻片变成可以探索的“变小探险”世界。
sparks.why_en: Whole-slide scanners are out of reach for most schools; their slide boxes sit in cupboards.
sparks.why_zh: 大多数学校买不起全玻片扫描仪，它们的玻片盒只能躺在柜子里。
sparks.prior_art_en: not yet searched (phone slide-scanning and open microscopes exist; we will credit them)
sparks.prior_art_zh: 还没检索（已有手机扫玻片和开源显微镜的做法，我们会注明出处）

sparks.line_en: A printed adapter and a phone app could turn one retired microscope objective into a measuring microscope that checks itself against a ruler on the slide.
sparks.line_zh: 一个打印的转接件加一个手机应用，也许能把一只退役的显微镜物镜变成会用玻片上的标尺自我校准的测量显微镜。
sparks.why_en: Retired lab optics are often thrown away; one good lens could be a school's first calibrated microscope.
sparks.why_zh: 实验室退役的光学件常常被扔掉；一只好镜头，可能成为一所学校第一台校准过的显微镜。
sparks.prior_art_en: not yet searched (phone microscope adapters are common; anything new would have to be the self-check)
sparks.prior_art_zh: 还没检索（手机显微镜转接件很常见；如果有新意，只能在自我校准上）

killed.name_zh: 沙拉甩干器细胞分选机
killed.reason_en: It separates things but shows nothing: no seeing core, so it fails X-WOW's first test.
killed.reason_zh: 它能把东西分开，却什么也没让人看见：没有“看见”的核心，第一关就不通过。

killed.reason_en: Not an invention of its own: it is a step inside SWELL's method, and stays there.
killed.reason_zh: 它不是一项独立的发明，而是 SWELL 方法里的一步，就留在那里。

killed.reason_en: Water beads are a known danger to young children: the UK Office for Product Safety and Standards warns that swallowed beads expand and can block a child's gut, needing surgery, and that the beads can also cause choking (safety alert, GOV.UK, 19 September 2024, read 12 October 2026). Not for a site children use, in any form.
killed.reason_zh: 吸水珠对小孩子是公认的危险：英国产品安全与标准办公室警告，吞下的珠子会胀大、堵住孩子的肠子，需要手术，也可能让孩子窒息（安全警示，GOV.UK，2024 年 9 月 19 日，2026 年 10 月 12 日读取）。孩子会用的网站，不以任何形式采用。
